import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_18/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_18/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_18/training_2.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # ['user_id', 'gender', 'age', 'occupation', 'zip']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # ['movie_id', 'title', 'genres']
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)  # ['user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating', 'timestamp']

# Step 1: Join Source3_18_2 and Source3_18_1 on movie_id
df_2_1 = pd.merge(df2, df1[['movie_id', 'title']], on='movie_id', how='inner')

# Step 2: Join the above result with Source3_18_0 on user_id
df_final = pd.merge(df_2_1, df0[['user_id', 'age', 'occupation']], on='user_id', how='inner')

# Reorder columns to match target schema:
# ['title': string, 'user_id': float, 'movie_id': integer, 'rating': float, 'timestamp': float, 'age': float, 'occupation': float]

# Ensure correct dtypes:
df_final['title'] = df_final['title'].astype(str)
df_final['user_id'] = df_final['user_id'].astype(float)
df_final['movie_id'] = df_final['movie_id'].astype(int)
df_final['rating'] = df_final['rating'].astype(float)
df_final['timestamp'] = df_final['timestamp'].astype(float)
df_final['age'] = df_final['age'].astype(float)
df_final['occupation'] = df_final['occupation'].astype(float)

df_final = df_final[['title', 'user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'age', 'occupation']]

# Write the final dataframe to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_18/target_multisource.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_18/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_18/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_18/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_18_2 and Source3_18_1 on movie_id
join_1 = pd.merge(source2, source1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Join the above result with Source3_18_0 on user_id
join_2 = pd.merge(join_1, source0, on="user_id", how="inner")

# Group by the leftmost non-float columns in target schema that are unique identifiers:
# According to target schema and hints, group by title (string), user_id (float but used as id), movie_id (int)
# Aggregate other columns by average to match target examples
result = join_2.groupby(["title", "user_id", "movie_id"], as_index=False).agg({
    "rating": "mean",
    "timestamp": "mean",
    "age": "mean",
    "occupation": "mean"
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
result = result[["title", "user_id", "movie_id", "rating", "timestamp", "age", "occupation"]]

# Write output to the specified file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_18/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
